# Draftroom Rounded Numerals

The numeric SVG outline data is adapted from the open-source Nunito variable font, distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. The digit one has been adjusted to omit the baseline foot. Original source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunito . The license and copyright notices are in OFL-Nunito.txt.

Only the 0–9 and colon outlines at weights 200–900 are included. No Apple font file is used. At runtime the clock produces high-resolution SVG images using those paths, preserving natural digit width and applying the selected height directly to the vector viewport. Glass tint is an SVG fill gradient, without bitmap resizing or text-shadow blur. Other clock families and numeral systems use their existing local system-font rendering.

`glass-numerals.js` contains display-size numeric outlines derived from Inter at optical size 32, weights 200–900, under SIL OFL 1.1; see OFL-Inter.txt. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter . The adaptive system style uses these outlines with the Liquid Glass material, while Classic retains the rounded outlines. Liquid Display can also be selected explicitly. SVG surface lighting adds clipped edge reflections without blurring the numeral silhouette. These are web approximations, not Apple's proprietary font or native Liquid Glass compositor.

Classic revision (November 2026): the Lock Screen now uses solid, unstretched numerals only. The six reference-inspired presets use rounded Nunito outlines, Inter outlines, and Bodoni Moda (optical size 96) serif outlines under SIL OFL. See OFL-BodoniModa.txt; source https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bodonimoda . Stencil cuts and broken double outlines are drawn as SVG effects. These are reference-based web recreations, not Apple font files or a claim of pixel-identical native typography.
